title: Mayer–Vietoris sequence for modules on a ringed space
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let U and V be open subsets with X=U\cup V, and let F be an O_X-module. Then there is a long exact sequence of abelian groups \(0\to H^0(X,F)\to H^0(U,F|_U)\oplus H^0(V,F|_V)\to H^0(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to H^1(X,F)\to\cdots\to H^{p-1}(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to H^p(X,F)\to H^p(U,F|_U)\oplus H^p(V,F|_V)\to H^p(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to\cdots\), where the maps are restriction and the difference of restrictions. The sequence is natural in F. If W'\subseteq X is open, then restricting the cover to U\cap W' and V\cap W' gives the corresponding sequence on W', and all restriction maps, including connecting maps, form a morphism of long exact sequences.
